title: featurePlanGraphUncertainty
responsibility: Classify committed graph uncertainty by possible page reachability.

inputs.name: references
inputs.description: Committed uncertain references for metadata overload.

outputs.name: featurePlanGraphUncertainty
outputs.description: String overload preserves generated trim. Metadata overload returns sorted deduplicated errors for page-reachable or unclassifiable uncertainty using reverse graph traversal without scenario edges. A dangling edge is ignored only when its existing origin is proven unreachable from active pages or the edge is scoped to a known scenario. Missing origins, page-reachable gaps, missing or duplicate graphs, and unknown ownership fail closed. Before ignoring references or non-scenario dangling edges, every active page must have a classified source node and committed ownership edge for each owned source file.
